proves.claim: Init in a copy of a scratch dotnet project records dotnet test as the gate.

cli.journeys-languages-csharp.init-recor.why: Without it, a regression where init stops detecting a dotnet project would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: A submitted commit with a failing xunit test is refused red and the refusal names the test.

cli.journeys-languages-csharp-red.a-fail.why: Without it, a regression where a red C# gate is accepted or its refusal hides the failing test would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: The fixed C# commit passes dotnet test, is accepted and lands on the scratch board main.

cli.journeys-languages-csharp-land.the-f.why: Without it, a regression where a green C# item cannot land would pass unnoticed.
